events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years Since Las Vegas Shooting
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas. He died six days later on September 13th.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac's music and powerful lyrics still resonate. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Remembering a Guitar Legend
events.blurb: It's 56 years since the world lost guitar icon Jimi Hendrix on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix's revolutionary guitar playing changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Something'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. 'Abbey Road' is 57 today! What's your go-to song from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Tribute
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and attitude have fronted The Pretenders for decades. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Released 55 Years Ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in the US in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Enduring Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it ever was. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod Launched 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed our music habits forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Favourite
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! Happy James Bond Day! Which Bond actor is your favourite, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring spirit and musical genius of John Lennon. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today. Born in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his humour is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of sonic exploration! The Beatles' 'White Album' was released today. Which track from this sprawling masterpiece is your favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the music world lost the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years on, Freddie Mercury's voice and showmanship remain unmatched. Remembering a true legend today. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Sound
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! This album marked a pivotal shift in The Beatles' sound. Which track from it do you love most?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we reflect on the tragic passing of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Message
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His message of peace and love lives on through his music. What's the song that reminds you most of him?
